description: Expand i18n infrastructure: fix formatPrice in I18nContext.tsx to use 'sdg' instead of 'egp' (MARBOU is Sudan-based, currency is Sudanese Pound), and create 3 organized translation JSON files (ui.json ~60 keys, marketplace.json ~60 keys, errors.json ~40 keys) for navigation, buttons, labels, marketplace fields, filters, and validation messages. Maintains backward compatibility with existing translations.ts.
steps: Modify Frontend/src/i18n/I18nContext.tsx: update formatPrice function to use t('sdg') instead of t('egp'); ensure 'sdg' translation key exists in translations.ts
Verify Frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: add 'sdg' translation key if missing (Arabic: 'الدينار السوداني', English: 'SDG')

Create Frontend/src/i18n/translations/ui.json: organize ~60 keys in { "ar": {...}, "en": {...} } structure for navigation (home, search, addListing, messages, account, login, logout), buttons (add, save, delete, cancel, apply, reset), labels (required, optional, error, success), placeholders (searchPlaceholder, enterName, etc.)

Create Frontend/src/i18n/translations/marketplace.json: organize ~60 keys for listing fields (title, description, price, condition, location), categories (vehicles, realEstate, electronics, etc.), search/filters (minPrice, maxPrice, city, filterLabel), sorting (newest, lowestPrice, highestPrice, relevance)

Create Frontend/src/i18n/translations/errors.json: organize ~40 keys for validation messages (required field, invalid email, invalid phone, invalid price), network errors (offline, slowConnection, retrying), and general errors (serverError, tryAgain)
Keep Frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts working: can remain standalone or import/merge the JSON files; do not break existing t() usage in components
acceptance_criteria: formatPrice now displays SDG currency (or 'الدينار السوداني' in Arabic)
ui.json, marketplace.json, errors.json created with proper structure ({ar: {...}, en: {...}})
All translation keys are properly scoped and organized by domain
Existing t() calls in components still work without modification
'sdg' key exists in translations and displays correctly
npm run typecheck passes with zero errors
verification: Import translations: verify new JSON files can be imported
Test price formatting: manual test in dev server shows 'SDG' or 'الدينار السوداني'
Verify existing pages still render correct translations
